##### Project general facts

Trump Tower Tbilisi by Archi & Invia is a landmark residential tower bringing the internationally recognised Trump residential brand to the region for the first time. Designed by Gensler, the tower combines a striking contemporary silhouette of glass, steel and distinctive vertical elements with a sculptural podium and landscaped surroundings. It rises above a ground floor and a four-level podium to fifty-eight residential floors, offering studios and one- to four-bedroom apartments with panoramic views of the city, the river valley and the surrounding mountains.

The tower is conceived as more than a residence, with hospitality-inspired amenities and services. Residents enjoy an indoor pool, panoramic rooftop pools, a thermal suite, a fitness centre and a yoga deck, together with a sky terrace, a panoramic bar and restaurant, a library and business lounge, meeting areas and co-working spaces. A kids' club, podium retail, a galleria, arrival gardens, park pavilions, hillside trails, public art and underground parking complete the offer, supported by concierge and valet services.

Interiors follow a refined contemporary aesthetic, combining floor-to-ceiling glazing with natural stone, oak and carefully selected premium materials to create bright, elegant and comfortable homes. Residences feature bespoke joinery, stone surfaces and designer fixtures, while panoramic glazing maximises natural light and views from every living space. Homes are delivered fully furnished with equipped kitchens, offering a complete, ready-to-live environment that combines understated luxury and craftsmanship with everyday practical comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Saburtalo is one of the most established and dynamic districts of Tbilisi, home to universities, medical centres, shopping facilities, restaurants and everyday services. The tower forms part of the Downtown Tbilisi masterplan, a large mixed-use destination where residences, offices, hospitality, retail and dining come together around landscaped public spaces beside Central Park, an extensive green setting for walking, recreation and outdoor activities.

The Delisi metro station is within walking distance, while major roads provide convenient access to Vake, the Old Town, Rustaveli Avenue and other key parts of the city. Tbilisi International Airport is within comfortable driving distance for international residents and second-home owners, and schools, clinics and supermarkets in Saburtalo serve families across the surrounding neighbourhoods every day.

Georgia allows foreign buyers to purchase residential property freely, and Tbilisi is one of the fastest-growing real estate markets in the region. Internationally branded residences are in very limited supply in the city, attracting high-net-worth buyers, expatriates and investors seeking premium rentals. A central location, metro access and the scale of the Downtown Tbilisi masterplan support long-term demand and value for owners and investors alike.
